name: byo-provider
description: Answer chosen loops (main, a subagent, a fork) with a model on your own Anthropic-format gateway by answering turn.step; every other loop stays on Claude. Env is never touched and the Claude credential is never sent to the gateway.

url.title: Gateway URL
url.description: Base URL of the Anthropic-format gateway (the mod posts to <url>/v1/messages).

token.title: Gateway token
token.description: Bearer token for the gateway. Kept in secure storage.

model.title: Default model
model.description: Gateway model used by /provider-switch use and agent when no model is typed.

timeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one gateway request may take before the step fails with a visible [byo-provider: ...] message.

agents.title: New subagents
agents.description: follow: a subagent or fork started by a loop on the gateway goes there too. claude: new subagents always run on Claude. /provider-switch agents changes it per session.
